display_name: The 2023 Merger Guidelines of the U.S. Department of Justice and Federal Trade Commission: Guideline 1's structural presumption, the frameworks of Guidelines 2 to 11, the section 3 rebuttals and the section 4 computations (agency enforcement policy, not law)
label: AGENCY ENFORCEMENT POLICY, NOT LAW
scope: What the Agencies presume, infer, examine, credit or accept under the 2023 Merger Guidelines, never whether a merger is lawful: the Guidelines 'create no independent rights or obligations'. Encoded: Guideline 1 (HHI as the sum of squared shares on 0 to 10,000, the change in HHI, the merged firm's share, the HHI limb over 1,800 with a change over 100, the share limb over 30 percent with a change over 100, footnote 15's bands); Guidelines 2 to 6 as their stated tests, with every indicator list taken from the caller and reported, not weighed; Guidelines 7 to 10 as what each setting does to the analysis; section 3.1 failing firm (requirements A, B, C, footnote 62) and failing division (footnote 64); 3.2 entry and repositioning (footnote 65); 3.3 efficiencies (footnotes 70, 71) and footnote 31; section 4's diversion ratio, aggregate diversion ratio, value of diverted sales, upward pricing pressure indicator, footnote 72's margin, the 4.3 tools, the HMT, the SSNIP and the pipeline's implicit price, recapture, critical loss, targeting, geographic shares, market participants, and shares from a measure as Guideline 1's input. Answers NOTHING: shares that are negative, over 100 or do not sum to exactly 100, or a market with no party; an HHI outside 0 to 10,000; a negative price, value, amount or time; an alternative offer at or below liquidation value that would decide the answer; an empty candidate market; a ratio with nothing to divide by. Not encoded: Guideline 11 beyond its types, the evidence discussion of section 4 (4.1, 4.2.A, 4.2.C to E, 4.3.B's framing, 4.3.D.3 to 8, 4.4's considerations), remedies, and the statutes.

forks.G1-1: the merged firm's share is the sum of the parties' pre-merger shares; the change is post minus pre (2ab for two parties)
forks.G1-2: shares must list every firm, each 0 to 100, summing to exactly 100, with at least one party; otherwise NOTHING (footnote 13's 16.67 x 6 = 100.02 is NOTHING)
forks.G1-3: 'creates or further consolidates a highly concentrated market' is a post-merger HHI over 1,800
forks.G1-4: the HHI is exact (10,000/6 for six equal firms); footnote 13's 1,667 is a rounding
forks.G1-5: footnote 15's moderately concentrated band is over 1,000 and at most 1,800
forks.G3-1: section 1's 'highly concentrated' inference is 2.3.A's first primary factor: post-merger HHI over 1,800 and a change over 100
forks.G3-2: the inference arises from concentration or prior coordination; any primary factor allows 'may conclude'
forks.G3-3: 'not highly concentrated' for the investigation is a post-merger HHI of at most 1,800
forks.G4-1: concentrated means an HHI over 1,000, or a future market with few equivalent potential entrants
forks.G4-2: a reasonable probability of entering a market over 1,800 satisfies element (2) of 2.4.A unless the effect would be de minimis
forks.G5-1: footnote 30's share is the foreclosure share of 2.5.A.2
forks.G5-2: footnote 30 says nothing of a share of exactly 50 percent, and a named result says so
forks.G5-3: concern (C) needs the ability to limit access or visibility into rivals' information, not the incentive
forks.G6-1: dominance is the caller's finding; the text gives no share figure
forks.G8-1: Guideline 1 'collectively' treats the firms of a series as the parties to one merger, on the shares before the first acquisition
forks.G9-1: the mapping of each platform scenario to the kinds of platform competition it engages
forks.G10-1: a benefit is weighed only in the market where competition may be lessened
forks.FF-1: footnote 62's bar applies to any rejected offer above liquidation value, whether or not less dangerous than the merger
forks.FF-2: an offer at or below liquidation value is unclassified, and NOTHING when it would decide the answer
forks.FD-1: footnote 62's definition and bar apply to a failing division
forks.EN-1: sufficient entry replicates one merging party on all of scale, strength and durability
forks.EN-2: entry is timely only strictly before any effect, both times in one unit
forks.EF-1: the four criteria make efficiencies cognizable; vagueness, the relevant market, nature-magnitude-likelihood and the monopoly clause condition crediting
forks.EDM-1: footnote 31's (b) decides merger specificity; (a) and (c) are reported
forks.TL-1: critical loss is the constant-cost breakeven L = Q s P / (P(1 + s) - C); a negative margin is NOTHING
forks.TL-2: recapture's 'exceed' and critical loss's 'less than' are strict
forks.TL-3: a SSNIP of zero percent or less is NOTHING

not_reviewed.note: No domain expert has read this against the Guidelines. No independent test pass has been run. Quotations have not been checked against the PDF, only against the deposited extraction. See NOTES.md sections 7 and 9.
